Vendored from https://github.com/da0ka/roadroller at commit `64614b5fc6c7a97d75315c4d8c9ca407e6f233a3`.

The build uses its `exe: 0` small decoder mode with six contexts for the optional `.speed.html` output. The fork describes this decoder as smaller and faster than its `zippable` mode. Its upstream license is included in `LICENSE.txt`; decoder code produced by Roadroller is public domain.
